meta.title: PartiDesign: two trainings, the second with the first frozen
meta.subtitle: The autoencoder learns a local latent; the flow matcher learns to generate it

transitions.label: same VAE
transitions.note: the autoencoder is never updated again after it is frozen

cards.title: Why there are two trainings and not one
items: The autoencoder learns an eight-dimensional latent per token: for a polymer residue it encodes identity, canonical atom coordinates, local geometry and torsions; for a ligand atom, element, charge and degree. Encoder and decoder are 12 Transformer layers each, token width 768
Its loss sums polymer coordinate error, polymer identity, ligand element, bond and charge cross-entropies, plus a KL term weighted 1e-4 with annealing disabled

The flow matcher then learns to transport Gaussian noise into the joint space of token centers and those latents, with the autoencoder held fixed and its posterior sample used as the clean endpoint. Generating structure and identity becomes one problem instead of two

cards.title: The part that makes co-design work
items: Centers and latents get independent noise times: tc from a mixture of uniform and Beta(1.9, 1.0), tz from uniform and Beta(1.0, 1.5). The model therefore learns global arrangement and local chemical identity at their own rates rather than sharing one schedule
The 14-layer denoiser (token width 768, 12 heads, pair width 256) uses pair-biased attention over every design and context token, so identity and geometry update against their surroundings together
Self-conditioning runs on half of training forwards: a no-gradient pass predicts a clean endpoint, which is detached and fed back in
Iterative pair updates and triangular multiplication are switched off in this configuration, which is where the claimed efficiency over an AlphaFold 3-like stack comes from

cards.title: A third network, trained separately
items: PartiScore is a mixture density network that ranks finished interfaces. It predicts a ten-component Gaussian mixture over the distance between token pairs from different molecules, trained by distance likelihood on contacts within 7 A
It uses no binding-affinity labels, no decoy classification and no contrastive negative poses; docking decoys are used only for monitoring
32 Ascend devices, global batch 256, up to 100 epochs of 1,000 steps. It reads structures directly and needs no VAE encoding
